description: Create a folder. parent_folder_id is optional: omit it for the team's top level (root), or pass a folder id from contents or search to nest it. Folders are optional and nestable; assets can also sit at root. This does not check for an existing folder with the same name (the app allows duplicates): call contents first if it may already exist. Returns folder_id and its url. To put assets in it, use items_update with folder_id, or pass folder_id to the upload tools. Needs edit access on the parent folder. Additive: nothing existing changes.

parent_folder_id.description: Folder to create it in, or "root" (the default) for the team's top level

name: folder_create
title: Create a folder
